# Causentra

> Open-source, privacy-first observability and tracing runtime for multi-agent AI systems across frameworks, providers, OpenTelemetry, and durable transports.

Causentra is a Python-first local runtime and portable event contract. It observes workflows, agents, model calls, tools, handoffs, and delegation without owning model clients or application credentials. Maintained adapters exclude prompts, outputs, tool arguments, arbitrary state, and error messages by default.

Status: public source release candidate. Do not describe Causentra as a hosted service, an agent orchestrator, automatic side-effect replay, compliance-certified software, or universally production-proven.
